# How to Data Compression with Strings

Source: [wiki article 5932](../archive/5932.md); edited 2025-05-11.

<a id="wiki-5932-n1"></a>

- Encoding large static vectors/strings into Custom String data can reduce element count, with runtime parsing/decompression cost.

<a id="wiki-5932-n2"></a>

- Example format uses semicolon-separated typed records c/n/s/v, comma-separated vector components, numeric sign/decimal parsing, and subroutines; decoder yields through a Wait for each decoded item.
